svg.title: EP2 C1 AREA 02
svg.desc: Matching colors: switches / fences Clock: timed switch Bulb: light control Green ring: healing Crossed squares: barriers / traps Box numbers: supply counts Letter / prime: warp pair Room 2: fire trap on the left of the entrance; clear the gatekeepers and go north. Optional 4a: Scape Doll, 3 weapon boxes and 2 armor boxes. One player can collect while the party advances. Hug the right side of the 4 → 5 hallway. Room 5 also has damage traps during combat.
